reason: My register has never failed me in all these years and I know every bill in it. Making my stylists take selfies and type numbers into an app when I already lost two good ones last year is not a risk I want to take for a free month.
objection: Many of my customers won't give their mobile number, so the whole thing about WhatsApp bills and reminders falls flat, and my staff will feel I am watching them.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running for a few months in a salon my size nearby, where the owner shows me the cash drawer check actually caught missing money and the staff did not leave over it.
